- [USER] The user is particularly interested in learning more about the history and cultural significance of Pongal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pongal is an ancient Tamil festival that dates back to the Sangam period (300 BCE - 300 CE).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The word "Pongal" comes from the Tamil word "pong," which means "to boil" or "to overflow."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pongal is celebrated to mark the beginning of the sun's journey towards the northern hemisphere and the end of the winter solstice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pongal is a four-day festival with the following days and their significance:
